title: Income-tax Act — Section 80C (Deduction in respect of life insurance, provident fund, specified savings and tuition fees)

content.overview: Section 80C allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of life insurance, provident fund, specified savings and tuition fees.
content.glance: Section 80C allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in respect of life insurance, provident fund, specified savings and tuition fees.
content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80C: Deduction in respect of life insurance, provident fund, specified savings and tuition fees. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
